paragraphs.text: Hurloon (hur-LOON ) is a mountainous region north of Llanowar , east of Benalia and south of the Whispering Woods on Aerona ( Dominaria ).

Hurloon lies north of Llanowar , east of Benalia , south of the Whispering Woods , and west of the Ironclaw Mountains . Hurloon lies at the point where North Aerona and South Aerona connect. Hurloon is dominated by its two main features - the Hurloon Mountains and the Hurloon Valley below. The mountains ring the valley on three sides, with only the east side being open toward the sea. The Hurloon Mountains, part of the metal-rich Red Iron Mountains , are mostly known for their habitation by hairy tattooed minotaurs . They live in small tribes, the largest of which lives in the fertile Hurloon Valley. The Hurloon Valley prominently features the Morningstar River, which runs through its entire length, and the majestic Morningstar Falls, which plummets from a high cliff in the mountains down into the valley. The ancient Dwarven Hold is also located in the Hurloon mountains and contains a considerable store of red mana . Kaldrooom was a city with a garrison where minotaurs had trained for centuries.
Hurloon Mountains - the eastern branch of the Red Iron Mountains Dwarven Hold - an ancient dwarven settlement and store of red mana Morningstar Falls - source of the Morningstar River

Hurloon Valley - a fertile valley hosting the largest habitations of minotaurs Kaldroom - formerly a large garrison, ruined in the first Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria . Morningstar River - runs from the Morningstar Falls to the sea

The minotaurs of Hurloon arrived in North Aerona after being forced from their original homeland of Stahaan by the encroaching glaciers of the Ice Age . They had been traveling south until they encountered this impassable mountain chain, where they took shelter in the caves.

Torsten von Ursus 's belief that these minotaurs were more than savage beasts was revolutionary at his time, around 3500 AR . This belief is still prevalent among the less educated. Von Ursus studied minotaur philosophy in the Hurloon Mountains for several years.
By c. 3650, there were no orcs left in Hurloon, as the heavy Minotaur presence had driven them all away.
Though they were once one people before their emigration, the Hurloon belief system was seen as heretical by the Mirtiin and Stahaan minotaurs as late as 4185 AR.
The Hurloon minotaurs were devastated by the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , with the city of Kaldroom completely destroyed. However, some Hurloon minotaurs yet remain.
